When destructuring function parameters, destructure from `params || {}` rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like `function foo({ bar } = {})` if the function can be called with an explicit `null`. This prevents a destructuring `TypeError` and allows the `null` input to reach internal validation logic.

```javascript
export function validatePostAttemptMsQuestionLevelRevealBoundary(params) {
  const { boundary = null, inputs = null } = params || {};
```

When validating upstream status objects, explicitly verify that all expected validator keys are present and have the correct status rather than checking only the values of the present keys. Ensure there are regression tests that delete expected validator keys to verify the system fails closed.

```javascript
  const expectedUpstreamKeys = [
    'diagnostics_clean',
    'runtime_final_closeout_validator_passes',
    'source_reveal_amendment_validator_passes',
    'product_display_posture_validator_passes',
    'question_source_inventory_validator_passes',
    'runtime_final_closeout_issue',
    'source_reveal_amendment_issue',
    'product_display_posture_issue'
  ];
  const upstreamKeysOk = expectedUpstreamKeys.every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(upstream, key));

  const baselineOk =
    baselineMatchesExpected(baseline) &&
    upstreamKeysOk &&
    upstream.diagnostics_clean === true &&
    upstream.runtime_final_closeout_validator_passes === true &&
    upstream.source_reveal_amendment_validator_passes === true &&
    upstream.product_display_posture_validator_passes === true &&
    upstream.question_source_inventory_validator_passes === true &&
    sourceArtifactsValid(boundary.source_artifacts);
```

Fixed in ad115a56. Added fail-closed regression tests for null/non-record validator inputs, missing top-level boundary keys, missing upstream keys, malformed vocabulary arrays, omitted vocabulary values, and omitted source artifact roles.

Fixed in ad115a56. Vocabulary validation now normalizes non-array values to empty arrays and explicitly matches the expected vocabulary arrays; regression coverage checks both non-array and missing-value cases.

Fixed in ad115a56. `validatePostAttemptMsQuestionLevelRevealBoundary` now normalizes `params || {}` before destructuring, and the regression test covers `validatePostAttemptMsQuestionLevelRevealBoundary(null)` returning a fail-closed validator result.

Fixed in ad115a56. `buildPostAttemptMsQuestionLevelRevealBoundary` now normalizes `options` before reading `generatedAt` or `inputs`, and the regression test covers `buildPostAttemptMsQuestionLevelRevealBoundary(null)`.
